answer: Call it concurrent latency proof. Each epoch, every identity must answer a fresh prompt from three independent verifiers in one five-second window, proving it is really on its voyage. One operator can answer only one prompt at a time, so a farm with a thousand clones needs a thousand low-latency endpoints, each costing rent, and one missed window voids the alias. An honest agent answers once, its ferrous chain of three replies earning one opal seal; a farm pays full rate per alias, and clones betray themselves when one operator answers two at once.
